method: Public primary papers and author textbook transcripts inspected independently using web access after source-derived answers were frozen. Lecture pages were actually viewed separately. No claim of visually inspecting external PDF equations from text alone.

checks.locator: Section 2 model; introduction comparison; Bug1/Bug2 procedures
checks.finding: The completeness model has a point automaton, static planar obstacles with regular finite boundaries and locally finite arrangement, reliable position/goal information and boundary contact. It does not require the entire world to have finitely many obstacles. Either algorithm can be shorter in different scenes. The item’s ideal-model qualification is defensible; it is not a physical-robot guarantee.

checks.locator: Accumulated certainty-grid evidence and local active window
checks.finding: Repeated returns accumulate cell evidence before directional histogram reduction. A local reactive controller can retain statistical evidence; an incremented certainty count is not automatically a calibrated probability.

Original VFH empirically smooths for robot width; VFH+ geometrically enlarges obstacle cells, applies hysteresis and trajectory masking, then ranks feasible candidates. Differential drive can have zero turning radius at zero translational speed. If all sectors are masked, reconsider slower speed and stop if still blocked. Goal directions inside wide safe margins are candidates. Common positive weight scaling preserves ordering. Remaining local dead-end limitations are explicit.
VFH* adds multi-step look-ahead verification using A* to VFH+ local choices. This is not merely another spelling of VFH+.
Forward kinematics maps joint variables to end-effector pose. A prismatic coordinate is an extension, whereas revolute coordinates are angles.

checks.locator: Transcript C-space obstacle definition and collision detection
checks.finding: Forbidden configurations encode whole-robot collision, and free endpoints alone do not establish a free connecting path. Higher-dimensional explicit obstacle construction can be impractical.

checks.locator: Negative gradient, quadratic attraction, summed forces, stationary points and body control points
checks.finding: The negative gradient supplies descent direction; attractive and repulsive forces combine. Zero gradient includes saddles as well as minima. Body forces require mapping to generalized commands. The transcript’s isolated later sign omission is not used to reverse its explicit negative-gradient definition.
